services.name: Swim Team
services.desc: The Y introduced group swim lessons more than 100 years ago, and that commitment to water safety continues today. At the YMCA of Greater Birmingham, we help children across our community build the skills and confidence they need to be safer in and around water through. Lessons are offered for all ages and abilities. Financial assistance is available. YMCA members save 50% on group swim lessons. services.name: Summer Day Camp
services.desc: When the school day ends, the YMCA is just getting started. YMCA Afterschool Care provides students with a safe, supportive place to learn, play, and grow while giving parents and guardians peace of mind until the workday is over. At the Y, kids build friendships, develop confidence, and strengthen the values and skills that support success in the classroom and beyond. There’s truly no place like this place to spend the afternoon. blurb: We’re your local spot for health, fitness, and community, right on US-280, convenient to serve Greystone, Hoover, Chelsea, Inverness, Dunnavant Valley and more. Our YMCA is more than a gym it’s a place where families and individuals of all ages feel at home. Whether you want to reach a fitness goal or connect with others, you’ll find a welcoming atmosphere here.
